items.name: Essence Crystal
items.summary: Essence held in a stable quartz lattice. Auber records what made it possible.

items.name: Heat Core
items.summary: A provenanced concentration of heat, prepared for a Channelworks housing.

items.name: Caustic Core
items.summary: A provenanced caustic concentration, prepared for a Channelworks housing.

items.name: Light Core
items.summary: A provenanced concentration of light, prepared for a Channelworks housing.

items.name: Heat Conduit Fixture
items.summary: Oda's first contained Conduit housing, carrying the recorded origin of the core inside it.

items.name: Humming Shard
items.summary: It hums when you are not listening.

items.name: Bound Knot
items.summary: Tied by someone who meant it to stay tied.

items.name: Lesser Salve
items.summary: Restores a little health to one party member.

items.name: Salve
items.summary: Restores a useful measure of health to one party member.

items.name: Greater Salve
items.summary: Enough medicine to turn a grave injury into a survivable one.

items.name: Draught of Clearing
items.summary: Clears poison and closes a bleeding wound.

items.name: Quenching Draught
items.summary: Quenches burning and clears the eyes after a dazzling emanation.

items.name: Broad Antidote
items.summary: Draws out one affliction, whatever shape it took.

items.name: Stonebark Tonic
items.summary: Turns aside the next affliction that would take hold.

items.name: Venom
items.summary: Coats one weapon so its next strike leaves poison behind.

items.name: Firebrand
items.summary: Coats one weapon so its next strike keeps burning.

items.name: Briar Oil
items.summary: Coats one weapon so its next strike leaves a stubborn wound.

items.name: Flashsalt
items.summary: Coats one weapon so its next strike dazzles its target.

items.name: Solvent
items.summary: Reveals one unidentified curio while still in the field.

items.name: Lure
items.summary: Wakes the nearest roaming creature and draws it toward you.

items.name: Scent Mask
items.summary: Animals relying on scent hesitate; other senses and close contact do not.

items.name: Seamlight
items.summary: Its light leans toward the nearest usable portal seam.

items.name: Stillwater
items.summary: Coaxes a failing world into holding together a little longer.

items.name: Waystone
items.summary: Forces a way home immediately, carrying the whole haul with you.

items.name: Torch
items.summary: Pushes the dark back for the rest of this journey.

items.name: Farsight Draught
items.summary: Reveals the nearest site and a little of the country around it.

items.name: Cache Key
items.summary: Fits a lock in a world that is not this one.

items.name: Anchor Frame
items.summary: A carried binding strong enough to fasten one world back into the Atlas.

items.name: Chipped Blade
items.summary: Somebody's, once. It still holds an edge on one side.

items.name: Keen Blade
items.summary: Balanced, and cared for. Whoever left it did not mean to.

items.name: Ripping Hook
items.summary: It was made to open things that did not want opening.

items.name: The Long Grievance
items.summary: Nobody agrees on what it was first used for.

items.name: Bone Awl
items.summary: Ground to a point against something harder.

items.name: Raking Edge
items.summary: Notched all along one side, and the notches are the point.

items.name: Binder's Edge
items.summary: Marked along the spine in a hand you almost recognise.

items.name: Hairsplitter
items.summary: It has never once been resharpened.

items.name: Field Maul
items.summary: A weight on a handle. It asks nothing of you.

items.name: Banded Mace
items.summary: Ringed against the shock of its own work.

items.name: Anvilfall
items.summary: Two hands, and a moment's warning.

items.name: The Settled Argument
items.summary: Heavier than it looks, and it looks heavy.

items.name: Long Pick
items.summary: Reach, at the cost of everything else.

items.name: Warded Spear
items.summary: Keeps the thing you are fighting where it is.

items.name: Parting Needle
items.summary: Goes in where there is no gap, and makes one.

items.name: The Kept Distance
items.summary: Whoever carried this was never touched.

items.name: Split Board
items.summary: Held together by habit.

items.name: Banded Buckler
items.summary: Small, quick, and enough.

items.name: Tower Guard
items.summary: You can put the whole world behind it.

items.name: The Unarguable
items.summary: Nothing has got past it yet.

items.name: Padded Cap
items.summary: Better than the alternative.

items.name: Ridged Helm
items.summary: Turns a blow rather than taking it.

items.name: Visored Casque
items.summary: You see less, and you keep seeing.

items.name: Crown of Quiet
items.summary: It muffles more than sound.

items.name: Padded Guard
items.summary: Layered cloth and patience. Better than nothing, which is what you had.

items.name: Banded Guard
items.summary: Someone spent a winter on this.

items.name: Vaultplate
items.summary: Cold to the touch, and stays cold.

items.name: The Standing Wall
items.summary: It has outlived several people who deserved better.

items.name: Wrapped Hands
items.summary: Cloth, and knots you tied yourself.

items.name: Studded Gloves
items.summary: For holding things that object.

items.name: Gauntlets of Hold
items.summary: Your grip is no longer the weak part.

items.name: The Sure Hands
items.summary: They do not shake. You still might.

items.name: Worn Boots
items.summary: They have been further than you have.

items.name: Shod Boots
items.summary: Iron at the toe, for ground that bites.

items.name: Longstriders
items.summary: The map got smaller when you put them on.

items.name: The Unhurried
items.summary: You arrive when you meant to.

items.name: Bent Pick
items.summary: It works. That is the whole of its case.

items.name: Balanced Pick
items.summary: Swings where you meant it to.

items.name: Corebreaker
items.summary: Hard ground stopped being an argument.

items.name: The Willing Edge
items.summary: It seems to know what you were about to do.

items.name: Pressed Leaf
items.summary: From somewhere. You remember which.

items.name: Cold Compass
items.summary: It does not point north. It points somewhere.

items.name: Someone's Ring
items.summary: Too small for you. You keep it anyway.

items.name: The First Page
items.summary: Torn out, and kept, and never read aloud.

items.name: Two-Natured Blade
items.summary: One edge bites and the other tears. Nothing you could forge is two things at once.

items.name: Long Fang
items.summary: A tooth as long as your forearm, hafted short. It should not reach as far as it does.

items.name: Ranked Spear
items.summary: It goes through, and keeps going. Whoever was standing behind finds that out.

items.name: Barbed Edge
items.summary: Its backward thorns stay in the wound. Nothing needs to be spread on them first.

items.name: Living Hook
items.summary: It is sharper than it was last week. You have not sharpened it.

items.name: Quiet Knife
items.summary: It makes no sound going in and none coming out. Nothing notices you using it.

items.name: Bloodletter
items.summary: What it opens does not close. Not on its own, and not in time.

items.name: Warded Haft
items.summary: Something is written down the shaft in a hand older than yours. Crush blows slide off it.

items.name: Rubble Sling
items.summary: A broad sling and a pouch of carefully matched roadside stone.

items.name: Fired-Clay Guard
items.summary: Layered fired plates tied over a wooden brace; brittle, but honest protection.

items.name: Ironwork Blade
items.summary: A practical iron chopping blade with enough weight to keep its cut moving.

items.name: Copper Buckler
items.summary: A work-hardened copper face over a resilient timber core.

items.name: Silvered Helm
items.summary: A close helm whose pale fitted plates turn a glancing blow cleanly aside.

items.name: Golden Keepsake
items.summary: A small worked-gold pendant, made to outlast the story attached to it.

items.name: Quartz Point
items.summary: A clear mineral point fitted to a long shaft and kept away from lateral strain.

items.name: Obsidian Edge
items.summary: A dark glass edge assembled from replaceable flakes rather than one fragile length.

items.name: Saltward Pendant
items.summary: A sealed salt crystal worn close enough to cloud when the air changes.

items.name: Sulfurous Maul
items.summary: A dense hammer whose sealed yellow fitting leaves a reactive trace in a split surface.

items.name: Mercurial Gloves
items.summary: Jointed gloves balanced with enclosed liquid-metal weights.

items.name: Adamant Cuirass
items.summary: A fitted green-metal shell whose thin plates carry more force than their weight suggests.

items.name: Woven Sling
items.summary: Long fibres braided into a broad pocket and cords that release cleanly.

items.name: Timber Longbow
items.summary: A tall stave cut along the grain and backed where the bend asks most of it.

items.name: Pressed-Pulp Cap
items.summary: Layered pulp pressed into a light shell and sealed against rain.

items.name: Resinbound Boots
items.summary: Working boots whose seams and soles have been repeatedly sealed with resin.

items.name: Toxin Edge
items.summary: A fitted cutting edge with a sealed channel for a stable toxic preparation.

items.name: Sporeward Coat
items.summary: A supple coat quilted with dry spore-felt and kept behind a tight outer weave.

items.name: Reagent Field Pick
items.summary: A field pick with a treated head that shows fresh mineral under its first strike.

items.name: Ichor Hook
items.summary: A hooked edge whose reactive reservoir is isolated from the grip.

items.name: Rift-glass Rapier
items.summary: A narrow blue-glass point braced along facets that never quite meet.

items.name: Raw-Essence Pendant
items.summary: Unrefined Essence held inside a fitted lattice rather than allowed to disperse.

items.name: Mote Compass
items.summary: A singular compass whose captive Mote points toward changes that persist across the campaign, not north.

travellers.name: Noll
travellers.summary: Knows where an object will part before touching it. Keeps a ledger of the pieces that should not have been separated.

travellers.name: Halloway
travellers.summary: Kept the fire in. Says a forge is only a fire someone stayed with.

travellers.name: Mara
travellers.summary: Measured things for a living. Still does, out of habit.

travellers.name: Edren
travellers.summary: Was digging when it happened. Has not stopped.

travellers.name: Isolde
travellers.summary: Taught the Art before there was anything left to write about. Still teaching, to nobody.

travellers.name: Sela
travellers.summary: Was always leaving. This time it took.

travellers.name: Auber
travellers.summary: Separates a thing from what carried it. Never calls what remains nothing.

travellers.name: Tovin
travellers.summary: Wrote worlds before you did. Knows what that costs.

stations.name: Writing Desk
stations.blurb: Compose a book and bind a world.

stations.name: Storehouse
stations.blurb: What you hauled back. Identify the strange things.

stations.name: Party
stations.blurb: Gear and gambits. Edited here, never mid-fight.

stations.name: Essence Spring
stations.blurb: Refine Raw Essence, deepen the return trickle, and unlearn combat techniques.

stations.name: The Library
stations.blurb: Everything anybody wrote down about where they went.

stations.name: Trading Post
stations.blurb: Sell identified holdings and buy from Vance's rotating ordinary stock.
stations.buildBlurb: Vance can set out a ledger and a table here for anything your household should not keep.

stations.name: Recycler
stations.blurb: Take eligible gear apart without inventing where its useful material came from.
stations.buildBlurb: Noll can fit a sorting bench here, leaving failed joins intact until their evidence has been recorded.

stations.name: Blacksmith
stations.blurb: Reforge what you carry into something better.
stations.buildBlurb: Halloway will raise a forge here, if you can find the stone and the iron for it.

stations.name: The Tannery
stations.blurb: Fit flexible living material into protection and carrying work.
stations.buildBlurb: Corrin needs beams, fibre and salt enough to prepare a clean working room.

stations.name: The Bowyer
stations.blurb: Fit far-reaching physical weapons without an ammunition inventory.
stations.buildBlurb: Fen needs straight stock, patient fibres and enough resin to make every draw hold.

stations.name: The Armoury
stations.blurb: Rebuild one familiar protective piece around a deliberate defensive Construction.
stations.buildBlurb: Bracken needs iron, clay and copper enough to rebuild protection without pretending its old shape was sacred.

stations.name: The Weaponsmith
stations.blurb: Fit advanced physical weapons to repeatable motion, reach and consequence.
stations.buildBlurb: Maud needs enough iron and copper to test the alteration, and a little gold for the measures that must not drift.

stations.name: The Scriptorium
stations.blurb: Learn to write smaller, and to say more with less.
stations.buildBlurb: Isolde needs a room with good light and a table that doesn't rock. She is very specific about the table.

stations.name: The Firepit
stations.blurb: Somewhere for the people you bring home.

stations.name: The Bestiary
stations.blurb: Everything you have met out there, and how the one you met compared.

stations.name: The Survey Post
stations.blurb: Instruments for reading a world you are standing in.
stations.buildBlurb: Mara wants somewhere flat, out of the wind, with a clear line to the horizon. She has been carrying the lenses this whole time.

stations.name: The Apothecary
stations.blurb: Remedies and preparations made from what the worlds grew.
stations.buildBlurb: Nessa needs a clean room, vessels that can take heat, and shelves for what the worlds grew. Raising it makes Lesser Salve available immediately.

stations.name: The Reliquary
stations.blurb: Edren's record of where people once stood, and what they left behind.
stations.buildBlurb: Edren needs shelves for fragments, broad tables for plans, and somewhere every recovered thing can keep its place.

stations.name: The Wayfarer's Table
stations.blurb: Field notes and packing methods for bringing home more of what the worlds grow.
stations.buildBlurb: Sela wants one broad table for field guides, samples and careful packing—not a counter, and not somewhere she is expected to stay.

stations.name: The Distillery
stations.blurb: Attune Essence Crystals through world-made samples.
stations.buildBlurb: Auber needs vessels that make every fraction visible, and shelves where no residue is mistaken for nothing.

stations.name: The Channelworks
stations.blurb: Oda gives concentrated emanations a route and a boundary.
stations.buildBlurb: Oda needs a bench where a live core can be contained before it is given reach.

stations.name: The Anchorage
stations.blurb: Worlds rebound into the Atlas, kept where they can be reached again.
stations.buildBlurb: Tovin needs a quiet room for the Atlas and a frame stout enough to hold open a way that should have closed.

terminology.name: Sigil
terminology.summary: A written symbol placed on a Page to help describe a world.

terminology.name: Subject
terminology.summary: The part of a written request that says what the request is about.

terminology.name: Focus
terminology.summary: A linked Sigil that asks the world to change its Subject.

terminology.name: Modifier
terminology.summary: A Sigil that changes how a connected Focus is applied.

terminology.name: Compound
terminology.summary: A reusable Sigil that preserves one complete written statement in a smaller footprint.

terminology.name: Route sketch
terminology.summary: Found writing that preserves one short path without revealing its destination.

terminology.name: Resource deposit
terminology.summary: A harvestable concentration of one world resource at a specific place.

terminology.name: Armour threshold
terminology.summary: The armour value above which a Gambit condition becomes true.

terminology.name: Village
terminology.summary: The home hub where the player prepares, builds, researches, and meets people between expeditions.

terminology.name: Shared progress
terminology.summary: Motes, Bestiary entries, and lifetime statistics kept across saves.

terminology.name: World preview
terminology.summary: A disclosure-safe preview of the world a Page may create before binding.

terminology.name: World pressure
terminology.summary: One named input—such as Hydrology, Illumination, or Growth—that helps shape generation without promising exact tiles or contents.

terminology.name: Normal world
terminology.summary: A standard generated world without a special authored starter identity.

terminology.name: Essence available
terminology.summary: The amount of refined Essence available at the point described. When a displayed total includes Raw Essence that could be refined, the copy must say ‘after refining’.

terminology.name: Worlds you can afford
terminology.summary: An advisory estimate based on stated Essence and a stated recent or current world cost.

terminology.name: World written by you
terminology.summary: A world created from the player’s own Page rather than a system-authored comparison.

terminology.name: Upgrade
terminology.summary: One learnable entry in Research, where every listed earlier Upgrade is required.

terminology.name: Skill
terminology.summary: One learnable combat ability; alternative earlier Skills may offer different legal routes.

terminology.name: Mastery
terminology.summary: A permanent campaign-wide improvement purchased with Motes through the Constellation.

terminology.name: Construction
terminology.summary: The physical build chosen for a piece of gear, determining its parts, appearance, and construction-dependent stats.

terminology.name: Expedition record
terminology.summary: The saved account of one expedition’s outcome and returned gains.

terminology.name: Saved at the time
terminology.summary: A value preserved when an event happened so later tuning cannot rewrite history.

terminology.name: From an older save
terminology.summary: Content retained from an earlier app version without pretending every current detail is available.

terminology.name: Writing found
terminology.summary: Writing brought home and retained as knowledge after an expedition.

terminology.name: Joined the village
terminology.summary: A person newly welcomed into the community after an expedition.

terminology.name: XP earned
terminology.summary: Experience earned by each party member, including any level-ups.
